final: {"prompt": "A square abstract painting filling the entire frame edge to edge, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Purely nonrepresentational: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Palette: a deep ink-indigo ground with veins of cold cyan and a few hot, controlled flashes of vermilion and pale gold, with some areas of murky gray-violet. Composition: a dense, tightly layered cluster of loose, fast brushstrokes in the upper-left that thickens into impasto, pulling against a sparse, quiet expanse of thin, almost bare canvas in the lower-right. Gestures range from sweeping arcs to short, hesitant dabs and a few scraped lines. Textures alternate between smooth glazed passages, dry-brush drag, and heavy knife-applied ridges. Rhythm: repeating diagonal strokes that stutter and break, creating a sense of pressure and release. Spatial tension: warm forms appear to push forward against cool recessive layers, with one strong contrast edge running diagonally across the middle. Leave deliberate pockets of empty space to let the tension breathe. Painterly, expressive, high-contrast, with visible drips and layered glazes."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
